descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
BLOXER is a classic match-4 formula, but with punching!

**PHYSICAL MATCH-4**

BLOXER mixes the classic match-4 formula with a physical fitness twist. Combine at least 4 blocks of the same colour to clear them and gain points. The one who can manage their board better is sure to become the winner. The movement of those blocks, however, is not simply controlled by moving the controller - you have to physically punch your robot ‘’friend’’ to affect the movement of blocks! Uppercut, jab or punch depending on the current situation on the board. 

[media]

**DYNAMIC 9-PLAYER MULTIPLAYER**

Match up in intense 9-player matches and compete for the title of the best BLOXER. The competitors are not only there for show, as they can and WILL interfere with your board and plans. But, you also know how to play dirty - overflow them with Garbage blocks and defend your board by counterattacking accordingly. Outsmart AND outpunch your enemies to WIN!

[media]

**COMBOS**

Chain your colour matches one after another to get combos! The bigger and longer combo you make, the more points you get and the more Garbage you can send your opponents’ way. But the timing is pretty tight - so spam punching is not recommended! Better prepare your board ahead of time for the biggest combo breaker.
